The '''Lavaflow Traverse''' was a tunnel in [[the Tomb]], an ancient [[Prison/Legends|prison]] complex on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] that connected two caves in the Tomb&mdash;the [[Ancient Stasis Zone]] and the [[Ancient Rakatan Keep]]. A rock pathway, it was named for the fact that the tunnel was full of molten lava and the rocks that formed the path protruded from the lava.
